caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with decorative elements on its front panel. The chest is shown in a three-quarters view, with the lid and the right side portrayed in a brownish color, and the main front face in a lighter, yellowish-cream tone. The front panel features two stylized trees, each with a thin trunk and numerous branches, decorated with red, pink, and gray leaves or flowers. Between the two trees, there is an ornate symmetrical pattern composed of curved lines and leaf-like forms, also in shades of red and gray. The chest has a molded rim at the top and bottom edges, with the molding colored a darker brown. The base of the chest is slightly recessed with curved cut-out sections at the corners, resembling feet, and the molding at the base matches the top edge in style and color. The overall background of the drawing is a plain off-white or beige color. The name "Malcolm Hackney" is faintly visible at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pa. German Chest
